Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent made an error in Step 1 by failing to accurately extract the information from the search results. Although the search results explicitly stated in the Wikipedia snippet that the series "premiered on March 16, 2017, on Crackle," the agent incorrectly concluded in its summary that the show is streaming on "Amazon Prime Video." This was a hallucination or misinterpretation of the data (likely confusing current availability listings seen in other parts of the search results with the original premiere platform), leading the entire conversation down the wrong path and preventing the correct answer (Crackle) from being definitively established in the first turn.
